task: Choose an effects optimization for the W4 D18 deep-specialization workload using measured work counts.
observation: Before memoization, concrete_function_observable_effects ran 2,621,451 times for 37 distinct function/concrete-type inputs (maximum recursion depth 19). The effects fixed point ran one round with zero changing rounds. The optimized specialization-stage profile after memoization reports 110 evaluations, 38 computations, 72 hits, and 19 distinct inputs, with each key computed once per independent pass.
impact: The counts support memoization rather than changing effects fixed-point convergence. D18 Callgrind Ir fell 72.5% from W2 to W3, and total Ir fell on each of the eight profiled workloads.
evidence: Callgrind 3.22.0 W2/W3 attribution summarized in docs/phase26/W3_RESULTS.md

resolution.summary: Memoization was implemented with summary-epoch invalidation and independent recomputation for specialization passes one and two. Local make check passed 140/140; hosted PR run #15 passed applicable jobs. PR #18 remains unmerged.
